Check My Leave Balance and History

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to see how many leave days you have left, review the status of every request you have submitted, and check the leave allocations you have been granted.

1. Open Time Off

Open the Time Off app.

2. Your balance

This card shows how many days of this leave type you have left. Click it to continue.

3. My Time

Open the My Time menu.

4. My Time Off

Open My Time Off to see all your requests.

5. Request status

The Status column shows whether each request is approved, refused or waiting for approval. Click it to continue.

6. My Time again

Open the My Time menu again.

7. My Allocations

Open My Allocations to see the leave days you have been given.

8. Your allocations

This list shows every allocation you received. Click the column headings to finish.
